name: Ricardo Alonso
bio:
Ricardo's path to motorsport was unconventional, starting with a degree in industrial engineering before transitioning to Formula Student. He quickly found his passion in the operational aspects of racing, excelling at coordinating logistics and resource allocation. His sharp analytical skills and relentless pursuit of efficiency led him through the ranks, from smaller teams to finally landing at PEX Motorsport.

As Head of Operations, Ricardo is known for his meticulous planning and ability to anticipate potential problems before they arise. He believes in empowering his team through clear communication and fostering a collaborative environment. While demanding, he is respected for his fairness and unwavering commitment to achieving peak performance.

Ricardo's distinctive approach lies in his data-driven decision making and his ability to blend technical knowledge with strong management skills. He thrives under pressure and is always seeking ways to optimize processes, making him a valuable asset to PEX Motorsport.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo is of medium build, with a serious but approachable demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Insists on a strict 15-minute team briefing every morning.
Has a collection of vintage racing posters in his office.
